description: Unofficial Kentaro Kyotani fan-art companion inspired by Haikyu!!. Independently drawn in his white-and-teal number 16 school uniform, with short blond hair and dark side accents. Original motions feature short explosive practice steps, a calm soft-volleyball rotation, kneepad inspection, a harmless footing reset, a low jump and three-direction articulated running. Familiar costume cues are artistic interpretations rather than newly verified official costume pixels. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
